Date: Sun, 12 Jul 2026 09:17:00 -0700
Subject: Exec brief: competitor pricing & model releases — QBR prep

Team — attaching a focused competitor roundup for the QBR prep next week (see attachments). High-level observations: 

- GrayBox.ai announced a tiered pricing change yesterday: publicized list prices down ~20% for their mid-tier endpoints; they are rolling volume credits tied to sustained throughput.
- CloudRun Partners published a model-compatibility guide and is promoting a latency-optimized quantized variant (claiming 2–3x inference cost reduction at 512 tokens).
- A smaller open-source release (repo: fast-llm-1.3) shows decent perf for short-context chat; potential threat for low-cost embeddings.

Immediate asks for QBR deck (deadline: EOD Tue):
1) Sales: short impact note on GTM/pricing motion — 1 slide (owner: Karthik)
2) Product: model-performance delta + risk assessment — 1 slide (owner: Rishi)
3) Ops: cost/throughput sensitivity for Dedicated customers — 1 bullet (owner: Laura)
4) CS: customer signals for migration/discount asks — 1 bullet (owner: Evelyn)

Attachments: 2026-07-12_competitor_matrix.xlsx, pricing_trends_2026.pdf

Please reply with owners confirmed or reassign by EOD today. I put proposed talking points in the matrix.

-Markus

Thanks Markus — I can own the Ops bullet and will include a short note on Dedicated commit sensitivity (expected impact on 3 typical customer profiles: SMB app, Mid-market SaaS, Enterprise).

Quick POV: GrayBox's public price drop looks intended to win mid-market trials — our risk is acceleration of eval cycles rather than immediate churn. Callouts for the slide: pricing elasticity at 10k–100k tokens/day, friction around model-quality tradeoffs, and a recommended playbook (short-term credits + quality-focused demos).

Rishi — can you push your latest 95th percentile latency numbers for the 13B and quantized 7B variants? I want a short table (latency / cost / perf delta) to drop into the Ops slide.

Also tagging Karthik for the sales slide — one ask: can we include any anecdote about prospects asking specifically about cost per token? (I heard from Marta Lopez at BigClient that cost is being used to widen negotiations.)

-Laura

Laura — attaching a quick heatmap (latency_heatmap_q2.png) and the short table below. Numbers are from our Dedicated clusters (p99s are stable for Q2).

- 13B fp16: 95th pct token latency 24ms, cost unit baseline 1.0
- 7B int8 (quantized): 95th pct token latency 9ms, cost unit ~0.42 (in our stack, excluding net egress)
- Short-context (<=128 tokens) batched throughput favors smaller models; 7B quant is ~2.5x more efficient for embeddings use-cases at low latency targets.

Attachment: latency_heatmap_q2.png

If you need a CSV for the slide I can paste it into the Drive folder.

-Rishi
